_comment: Project checks, added to the baseline checks built into tools/hooks/hooks.mjs (BASE_REQUIREMENTS). An entry with a baseline tag overrides it; turning a baseline check off needs disabled: [{tag, reason}]. Each entry: when (all true) -> require (all must hold), else block with message. Conditions: promptMatches, promptNotMatches, answerMatches, answerNotMatches, minToolCalls, workTurn, filesChanged, allFilesChanged, toolRan, toolUsed, resultMatches, fileRead, playbookRouted, playbookUsed, skillUsed, toolPassed {cmd, pass, selfRun}, runEach {files, cmd}. Every tag needs a row in docs/checks/rule-enforcement.md and a test in tools/hooks/test-hooks.mjs.

requirements.message: Save the plan to docs/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md (plan skill) and link it in the answer, then ask the user to review it before work starts.
Debug skill: state the root cause in the answer ("Root cause: <what and why>") with the evidence that shows it, found before the fix.
Parallel-agents skill: run the full checks on the combined result after the last change, and say in the answer what they showed, part by part.

Research skill: every fact needs its source in the answer: the link of the page it was read on (with a date for anything that changes), or the project file it came from, or say plainly that nothing is recorded in the project.
Research skill: the answer says it is verified, so its ledger must pass: node skills/research/scripts/claims.mjs check .cache/research/<slug>.md, and fix every ERROR.
Skill-finder skill: report the search in the answer: "Existing skills checked: <where> - <result>".
Plan skill: run node skills/plan/scripts/plan-tasks.mjs check <plan> and fix each warning (or give its reason) before handing the plan over.
Security-review skill: end with the report table: every area PASS, FAIL or N/A with its evidence, and where each open FAIL went.
